digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and class resolution
propositions: Add three model class slots (trivial, standard, frontier) to config schema, each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array
Implement resolver that maps class name to provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted
Env vars address structured slots by field with REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_<FIELD> pattern, maintaining existing precedence rule per key
Fallback entries are non-recursive provider targets with model (required), provider (optional), endpoint (optional), and api_key forbidden
load_class_slots() entry point reads model_classes sub-table from merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and returns resolved slots
Per-class defaults preserve byte-identical current behavior when slots are unconfigured: frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5
